import ctypes,os
def inspect():
    libc=ctypes.CDLL(None,use_errno=True)
    before=libc.prctl(3,0,0,0,0);r,w=os.pipe();pid=os.fork()
    if pid==0:
        os.close(r)
        if libc.prctl(4,0,0,0,0)!=0:os._exit(2)
        os.write(w,str(libc.prctl(3,0,0,0,0)).encode());os.close(w);os._exit(0)
    os.close(w)
    try:data=os.read(r,32)
    finally:os.close(r)
    _,s=os.waitpid(pid,0)
    if os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(s)!=0:raise RuntimeError('child prctl failed')
    return int(data),libc.prctl(3,0,0,0,0)==before
